questions.question: Describe superfast trains in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Superfast trains in India are trains that run at a higher speed than ordinary express
  • trains. They are designed to provide faster and more comfortable travel, make fewer
  • stops, air-conditioned coaches, comfortable seating, catering, and Wi-Fi services
  • ensuring shorter travel time. Eg: Rajdhani Express, Shatabdi Express, Duronto
  • Express, Gatimaan Express, and Vande Bharat Express.
  • Long Essay Questions
